task_assessment.objective: Finish the broad request after clipping is not supported and harmonic analysis is invalid.

claims.statement: Clipping is not supported because the clipping ratio rule PASS and flat-top rule PASS indicate no substantial clipping, despite clipping_mechanism=true. Harmonic analysis is invalid because the fundamental bin energy is below the reliability threshold, so harmonic distortion cannot be established.

limitations: Harmonic distortion analysis is invalid because the fundamental bin energy is below the reliability threshold; causal S1 distortion attribution is not supported.
Clipping is not supported because the clipping ratio is below the configured threshold and no flat-top is detected, so the sparse full-scale samples do not constitute substantial clipping.
